report_name: Royal Borough of Windsor & Maidenhead Local Cycling & Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: Used to create a data-driven approach to developing a cycle network and identify routes with the greatest potential; results were cross-referenced with public engagement feedback.
specific_evidence_of_impact: Budget of £1.5 million approved for 2022/23; identification of priority corridors for study.
quotes_on_using_pct: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) for England and Wales provides an evidence base to inform cycling investment.
The 'Go-Dutch' Scenario has been used to understand which routes provide the greatest potential.
